entries.question: Confirm the Mission intent for #6488: platformdirs semantics win for per-user cache, state and config; kernel.user_dirs is the single authority and every caller routes through it; old locations are discarded; macOS/Windows branches pinned by faked-platform tests.
entries.rationale: Operator triage on #6488 (2026-10-19) names the rule, the scope list, the dead fallbacks and the cleanup; the brief's mission boundary is one issue to one PR, so #2904 stays out.
